test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the appropriate antonym for the underlined word.

There can't be anything __positive__ about plastics with pathogens floating around.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Depreciative'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate antonym for the underlined word 'positive' is option 3)** 'depreciative'.**
 
• **'Positive'** in this context refers to something beneficial, favorable, or good.(सकारात्मक).
 
• Therefore, the **antonym** should represent something **unfavorable or bad.**
 
• **'Depreciative'** fits this description as it refers to something that lessens in value or is derogatory.(अवमूल्यन करने वाला).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Depreciative'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the meanings of all the words in English and Hindi:
 
 
• **'Approving' **- Showing or feeling admiration or approval (अनुमोदन).
 
• **'Flattering' -** Full of praise and compliments (चापलूसी).
 
• **'Fundamental' **- Forming a necessary base or core; of central importance (मौलिक).
 
 

193:Tb13,

The correct answer is 'Option 2' <
